caption: The drawing features a central human-like figure outlined in black, sitting or standing in the center, surrounded by several four-legged animal figures, some of which resemble deer or dogs, depicted in blue, pink, or yellow with black outlines. The background is filled with a mosaic of bright colors, including red, pink, yellow, blue, and brown, forming abstract shapes and patterns. In the upper portion of the drawing, there is a circular yellow and blue design resembling a wheel or sun, while on the right side, another circular yellow shape encircles a face-like design made with blue and pink lines. The lower edge of the composition shows additional geometric shapes in blue, yellow, and gray. The overall drawing is bordered by a thin yellow line and a thicker red margin. In the lower left corner, three cords made of pink and red threads are intertwined in a decorative braid extending from the artwork.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
